rows.name:
Doctor Smaia came back, said, 'You can
have this clinic,' and left again...

rows.label: tlk4530005803_msg0002
rows.name:
I mean, I'm sure I can handle
things on my own. I've watched
the Doctor at work for many years.

rows.label: tlk4530005803_msg0003
rows.name:
But a lot of our regular patients
are saying they're going to miss
Doctor Smaia's brusque attitude.

rows.label: tlk4530005803_msg0004
rows.name:
Should I... try speaking...
more briefly too...?
